en: A black‑and‑white aerial view over a vast, forested hilly landscape with lakes in the distance. On a rocky hilltop stands a large multi‑storey building complex, likely a hotel or lodge, with a flag flying from a flagpole. The scene is surrounded by dense coniferous forest. In the lower left corner the printed caption reads "KOLI 964". The image has a white border typical of vintage photographic postcards.
